svg.text: Logging in from the browser: cookies, CORS, and localhost
Concept 9 · wristband = the access cookie (15 minutes) · season pass = the session cookie (7 days, only to /auth/…)
204: this origin is allowed, cookies may come along
click Log in on the form;
Set-Cookie: access=…; Max-Age=900; Path=/; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict
Set-Cookie: session=…; Max-Age=604800; Path=/auth; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict
the browser keeps the access wristband and the session season pass;
HttpOnly: even the page's own JavaScript can't read them
a GET without special headers: no preflight
401 not logged in or session expired
no body: no preflight · session comes along: its address starts with /auth
200 + a new wristband + a new season pass
the season pass is checked in
refresh 401 too (season pass expired) → only then the login screen shows
fetch(BASE + path, { credentials: "include" }) in src/api.ts: without credentials, the browser doesn't attach cookies
to another origin and ignores the Set-Cookie in its response. Tokens are never stored in localStorage.
A different origin, the same site
(the backend's CORS_ORIGIN has included it since Module 20)
A site doesn't look at the port: localhost = localhost
A page at http://127.0.0.1:5173 that calls the API on localhost:
cookies are neither stored nor sent → login 200, then
straight back to the login screen.
The fix: always open http://localhost:5173. The default API
address follows the page's host name (location.hostname).
